[tips] Remove NotificationsTestUtils and use typed Public Transit calls

NotificationsTestUtils.clickPositiveButton() switched on the feature
type and returned Object, so callers depended on unchecked casts and
untyped varargs. Inline the typed transition in each test instead.

Also let LensIntentFulfilledCondition tolerate repeated startLens()
calls and report what it saw, with the Lens tests verifying
startLens() runs once. Previously a duplicate call made the Condition
time out (verify() defaults to times(1) and AssertionError was caught
as notFulfilled), so this gives a clearer failure message instead.
interceptMoveTaskToBackForTesting() is dropped since startLens() is
mocked and never backgrounds the task.

[contextual_tasks] Guard chip anchor fallback, surface & indicator a11y

* Add LocationBar::ShouldFallbackToWindowContentsAnchor() (returning
  false on ContextualTasksLocationBar, true by default) and guard null
  anchors in PermissionDashboardController and ChipController. This way,
  late GetAnchor (which calls GetAnchorOrNull) returns null instead of
  the main browser window, and when no prompt bubble opens,
  ChipController resets the custom-cursor block and resumes the chip
  collapse/dismiss timer.
* Add LocationBar::ConfigurePageInfoBubbleSpecification() so Page Info
  bubbles opened from side panel permission chips record
  PageInfo::Surface::kContextualTasks instead of kDefault for UMA.
* Update the indicator chip's accessible name on every
  PermissionDashboardController::Update() regardless of
  ShouldNotifyAccessibility()'s lazy-update AccessibilityWasNotified
  (and clear it on HideIndicators(), with
  PermissionChipView::SetAccessibilityName("") calling RemoveName()), so
  switching tasks or moving a task to a tab after
  AccessibilityWasNotified is set never leaks another page's aria-label
  or degrades to a generic short title.
* Add LocationBar::CanAnnounceAlert() (overridden in LocationBarView,
  WebUILocationBar, and ContextualTasksLocationBar) to indicate when the
  side panel is open/alert can be shown. This way, alerts are only
  marked as notified when CanAnnounceAlert is true (the toolbar actually
  showed alert to the user), instead of silently dropping them while the
  panel is closed.
* Track the Permissions.ActivityIndicator.LHS.*.Show metric separately
  via IconShownRecorded so retrying a pending alert across Update()
  calls does not double-count UMA.
* NOTE: Companion CLs call Update() when reopening a task to show any
  pending accessibility alerts and set shown states added in this CL
  (https://crrev.com/c/8815086). Also, future CLs wire AnnounceAlert()
  to the panel's toolbar WebView (https://crrev.com/c/8811121).

[ChroMenu Search] Widen the icon-to-label gap on search result rows

All menu items used the menu's 12dp gap between the icon and the title.
Per the ChroMenu spec, search result rows use a 20dp gap while the
normal menu and the pinned notification row keep the 12dp gap.

Use `MenuItemView::SetIconLabelSpacing()` with
`DISTANCE_ACTION_APP_MENU_SEARCH_ICON_LABEL_SPACING` (20dp) on search
result rows.
